name: Wing Commander Abhinandan Varthaman
real_life_parallel: IAF pilot shot down over PoK 27 Feb 2019; captured and returned 60 hours later

biography.background: Indian Air Force MiG-21 Bison pilot. Shot down Pakistani F-16 before his own aircraft was downed by a missile over PoK on 27 February 2019. Captured by Pakistan Army, held for 60 hours. Released on 1 March 2019 under international pressure.
biography.capture_details: Parachuted into PoK; assaulted by mob before army rescue; viral videos of custody
biography.return: Handed over at Wagah-Attari border; became national icon
biography.viral_element: Mustache, calm demeanor in custody videos; 'cups of tea' video
biography.film_relevance: Part 3 centerpiece: Balakot aftermath; capture-return drama

capture_sequence.custody: Pakistan Army prevented mob lynching; interrogation videos released
capture_sequence.1_mar_2019: Released at Wagah; 'instrument of peace' Pakistani framing
